keybox

components · 0.2.0 · D1 · aj-c-keybox

A printed caps key, then its value: every date the product shows, and the price. The value is handwritten (the date, written in as the page arrives) or printed (a label or a price). On a pushed page with no wordmark the date box names the page and its value is the h1.
